CyberLink installer compromised to distribute malware.

Target: CyberLink
Repository: N/A
Date: 2023-10-20 to 2023-11-22 (33 days)
Attribution: Nation-state
Component: application
Language:
Cause: Vendor infrastructure compromise
Motive: Espionage, Data theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Backdoor, Remote access
User Impact: 100
Domain: cyberlink.com (project download host)
Artifact Type: binary archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

A North Korean group (Diamond Sleet/ZINC) modified a legitimate CyberLink multimedia software installer, signing it with a valid certificate. Hosted on CyberLink's update infrastructure, the trojanized installer (LambLoad) downloaded secondary payloads onto victim systems in multiple countries.

Compromised Versions

  • Specific CyberLink application installers (e.g., Promeo reported) active around Oct/Nov 2023
